annotations.text:
1 — At the load.
The moment the mistake is still cheap to fix. Warnings sit under the file they belong to, not in one pile at the top.

2 — In the history.
A problem keeps its panel, because it is still true. A notice shrinks to one line.
System_Test.xlsx would emit 6 warnings. Grouping the 4 empty columns into one line is what keeps that readable.
